items.name: Hand-test what has merged
items.line: These merged with only automatic checks and need you at the Mac. Main chat M1, required before it counts as done: run risky commands in Auto (deleting, pushing, installing) and see the card still ask and say why. Notch island 2 and 3: the note, a failed build, a long message, the eyes following the cursor, the panel at the side. Main chat M3 (about 5 minutes, on the real desktop): open a chat with your API key and watch the home fold into the one status line (working, waiting, images). Make something wait and click the amber count. Press New chat and see the cards come back. Try Reduce Motion, light and dark, and the notch and a moved panel. Look at whether a waiting session plus the API key note leave the thread too little room. Visual Review 1b to 3: a real turn, the big viewer's keys, a phone-width page. Visual Review 4 (about 3 minutes, steps in Feature building's report): turn on Hold the session for my review, ask for a visible change in the Claude desktop app, and look at the session while Steward's card counts down (does it look running, is there a stop button?). Send a note back and see whether Claude acts on it and how the note looks in the transcript. Type a message during a wait. Run claude /login first for the terminal, since its login has expired. Steward's moods (R1, R2): an hour of idle. Overnight Watch 1 to 3: a real night. Movable panel and notch 3b from before. Tell the front door what feels off; small things go on the Small fixes list.

items.name: Hold switch text is long
items.line: Four lines under "Hold the session for my review" in Settings. Suggest two lines of explanation plus one small consent line ("Adds one hook to Claude Code's settings."); the card says the session shows as running. Optional: a clock icon or warm color for the countdown on the card.

items.line: Steward's PermissionRequest hook would wait for your Allow or Deny and give it back to Claude Code, so a session's approval could be answered from the island. items.name: Steward dozes when idle
items.line: The reactions brief said the face dozes after 5 and 10 quiet minutes. It does not: at rest it is Resting right away and Sleepy only after midnight. A real dozing face (heavy lids at 5 minutes, asleep at 10, any event wakes it with a blink) would be its own small change.
